title: BACKND Base SDK utilities
summary: SDK utility helpers: server time (GetServerTime, UTC, usable without login), project status and version checks, signature hash retrieval (by function or Unity inspector), and SDK filesystem helpers.
capabilities: route utility questions (server time, project status/version, hash, filesystem)
note which utilities work without login (e.g. server time)
explain hash retrieval for signature verification
prerequisites: Login is required only for utilities that need an access token
common_pitfalls: Using device local time instead of GetServerTime for server-authoritative timing
Assuming all utilities require login (some do not)
Misreading UTC server time as local time
verification_required_for: exact method names and return fields
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating utility code.
Confirm login requirements and return shapes per utility upstream.
public_notes: Server time is UTC and usable without login; prefer it for server-authoritative timing.
Project status/version checks support maintenance and update gating.
